brief: A vibrant, cross-section view of a tide pool fills the canvas with richly colored, crystal-clear water. The entire scene is defined by constant, intricate background movement of subtle, swirling currents. When ripples expand outwards, the surrounding water responds dramatically, accelerating into visible, spiraling flows that radiate across the surface. Sunlight penetrates the water, catching these moving currents and making the entire environment appear luminous, highly dynamic, and perpetually flowing.
